E0226	`?` inside a lambda given to map		map keeps the Err as an element; use `try_map`, which stops at the first Err
E0227	`_` in a call on the right of `|>`		the piped value is always the first argument; to put it elsewhere, use a lambda: `x |> (v => f(1, v))`
E0228	the rest parameter `...%s` is always a list		annotate it `list` (or not at all); `list[int]` names the elements without checking them
